newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN SHARES STABLE, MAINTAIN SUMMER DRIFT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN SHARES STABLE, MAINTAIN SUMMER DRIFT.

text.p: Latvian shares stayed in their tight corridor of prices by the close on Thursday, drifting slightly higher amid marginally lower volumes, dealers said.
The bourse index added 0.45 percent to 383.74 while the Rietumu Bank index edged up 0.42 percent to 150.11.
The market's total turnover was 81,000 lats, slightly lower than Wednesday's 85,000 lats.
Dealers said the market was set to continue its summer drift, given a lack of new factors and the general sluggishness which besets the market at this time of year.
"I cannot really see anything that would liven things up before the autumn," said one trader.
The Latvian market's inactivity was in contrast to neighbouring Estonia, where shares keep powering to new highs.
Unibanka again made up most Latvian trade, turning over 44,100 lats to end two santimes higher at 3.29 lats.
Riga Shipyard was next most active but lagged a long way behind at 6,500 lats turnover and was unchanged at 1.32 lats.
Staburadze was also unchanged at 2.70 lats, trading 5,500 lats.
